responsibility: Declares the front end’s compilation-pass state machine. It provides setters and predicates for the no-pass state, parser passes 0/1/2/C/3, the hidden-type parsing pass, code-generation pass, and error pass, so modules throughout gm2 can adjust behavior according to the current stage of compilation.
same_name_distinction: Definition module for the M2Pass pair: it declares the pass-transition procedures and pass-state predicates used throughout the compiler, while `gcc/m2/gm2-compiler/M2Pass.mod` implements the single global pass variable and transition checks.
